content:
Apple is now rolling out new beta software to developers, including the third betas of iPadOS 27.2, tvOS 27.2, and more.

Third betas of iPadOS 27.2 and more arrive

Today's new betas are available to developers starting today, exactly two weeks after Apple's last update.

The third betas of iPadOS 27.2, tvOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2 and more are now rolling out.

Key features in the 27.2 betas so far include:

  • A new Health app with Apple Intelligence features
  • Apple TV profile feature comes to iPhone and iPad
  • Siri AI brings Mac-inspired Shortcuts functionality to iPad
  • Siri AI supports more languages

The third beta released today may add new features to this list. We'll keep you posted on anything we discover.

There may also be unannounced features related to upcoming hardware. Apple is rumored to be launching new home products, Macs, and more in the coming weeks.

There is no public beta of the third beta available yet, but it is expected to drop in about a day or two.

Have you found any new features in the iPadOS 27.2 third beta or any other updates? Let us know in the comments.

Best accessories for iPad, Apple Watch, and Apple TV

  • AirPods Pro 3 (now $179, originally $249)
  • Apple Watch portable USB-C charger
  • 100W USB-C fast charging power adapter
  • Siri Remote non-slip silicone case with AirTag compatibility
  • HomeKit smart plug four-pack
